Your Partners in Quality Home Remodeling
Remodeling Experts in San Diego, CA

At Kitchen Barn we transform houses into dream homes. We are a full-service design-build remodeling company, specializing in comprehensive home, kitchen, and bathroom remodels, ensuring your project is seamlessly executed from inception to completion.

With over 30 years of experience as a top remodeling company, our family-owned business is committed to delivering personalized, high-quality service to our clients throughout San Diego County.

Bringing Sophisticated and Stunning Designs to Your Home
Call to Make an Appointment

Kitchen Barn, Inc. is a family-owned design-build remodeling company based in San Diego, CA. We pride ourselves on our reputation for excellence, built through years of dedicated service and countless satisfied customers. Our hands-on approach, coupled with our extensive experience, ensures every project we undertake meets the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship.

As a locally owned remodeling company, we deeply care about our clients’ needs and the way they are treated. We have developed a strong reputation through our unwavering work ethic, with much of our work coming from referrals of past clients. Our clients consistently praise our dedicated customer service, high-quality product lines, and professional installation crews.

Transform Your Kitchen with Kitchen Barn
Breathe New Life into Your Kitchen
Contact Us

Is your kitchen looking outdated or lacking in functionality? At Kitchen Barn, we specialize in kitchen remodeling into beautiful, efficient spaces that cater to your needs and reflect your personal style. Whether you’re tired of the way your kitchen looks or seeking to enhance its functionality, our expert team is here to help you every step of the way.

Restore, Enhance, or Reinvent Your Kitchen
Your kitchen is the heart of your home, and it should be a place where you love to spend time. If your current kitchen isn’t meeting your expectations, you have several options to rejuvenate it:
Restore
Bring back the charm and original beauty of your kitchen with thoughtful restorations that preserve its character.
Update
Modernize your kitchen with the latest design trends, fixtures, and technologies to create a contemporary and stylish space.
Redesign
Completely overhaul your kitchen’s layout and style to better suit your needs and personal tastes.

Whether you want to restore your kitchen’s former glory, update its look with modern touches, or completely redesign it for a fresh new style, Kitchen Barn offers a comprehensive range of kitchen remodeling solutions tailored to your vision.

Imagine the Opportunities of a Kitchen Remodeling

Picture yourself walking into a kitchen remodeling that feels luxurious, functional, and truly reflective of your home’s value. A quality kitchen remodel by Kitchen Barn can transform your cooking space into a stunning centerpiece of your home. Our expert remodeling services can help you achieve:


Elevate Your Kitchen's Appeal
Enhance the look and feel of your kitchen with beautiful designs, premium materials, and stylish finishes.
1
Enhance Your Kitchen's Efficiency
Reconfigure your kitchen’s layout to maximize space, improve workflow, and enhance your cooking and entertaining experience.

Invest in Your Home's Future
A professionally remodeled kitchen can significantly increase your home’s market value, making it a wise investment for the future.
The Design-Build Advantage

Choosing a design-build firm like Kitchen Barn offers numerous benefits over hiring basic contractors. Our integrated approach ensures a seamless and efficient remodeling process:

Z
Single Point of Contact: From initial design to final construction, you work with one dedicated team, simplifying communication and coordination.
Z
Streamlined Process: Our cohesive approach minimizes the risk of miscommunication and delays, ensuring your project stays on track and on budget.
Z
Expert Guidance: Our experienced designers and builders collaborate to provide innovative solutions and expert advice, helping you make informed decisions every step of the way.
Z
Quality Assurance: With full control over the entire process, we maintain the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship, ensuring your complete satisfaction.
Restore Your Kitchens Beauty?

Take the first step toward creating the kitchen of your dreams with Kitchen Barn. Our team of experts is ready to guide you through every phase of your kitchen remodeling project, from initial concept to final completion.

Contact us today for a free consultation and let’s start building the kitchen you’ve always wanted! Experience the difference of working with a dedicated, experienced, and passionate team. Choose Kitchen Barn for your kitchen remodeling needs and transform your kitchen into a space you’ll love for years to come.

Whole Home Remodeling with Kitchen Barn
Elevated Design for Your Home
Contact Us

Are you tired of the way your home looks? Do you dream of a space that truly reflects your style and meets your needs? At Kitchen Barn we specialize in transforming outdated or uninspiring homes into beautiful, functional spaces you’ll love. With over 30 years of experience, our family-owned design-build firm offers comprehensive home remodeling services that make your dream home a reality.

Refresh, Update, or Redesign
Your home should be a place where you feel comfortable, happy, and proud. If you’re dissatisfied with its current state, you have numerous options to rejuvenate it:
Restore
Bring back the charm and functionality of your home with thoughtful restorations.
Update
Modernize your living spaces with the latest design trends and technologies.
Redesign
Completely overhaul your home’s layout and style to better suit your tastes and lifestyle.

Whether you want to restore its original beauty, update its look with contemporary features, or completely redesign it to match a new style, our team is here to help with home remodeling. We offer a wide array of options and work closely with you to ensure your vision comes to life.

Dream Big with Quality Home Remodeling

Imagine walking into a home that feels more luxurious, comfortable, and stylish—a space that truly reflects its real value. A quality home remodel by Kitchen Barn can make this dream a reality. Our expert team can transform your valuable property into a luxurious haven by:


Enhancing Aesthetics
Elevate the beauty of your home with our eye-catching designs and premium finishes.
1
Improving Functionality
Reconfigure your space to better suit your needs and lifestyle, making daily living more convenient and enjoyable.

Increasing Property Value
A well-executed remodel can significantly boost your home’s market value, making it a wise investment for the future.
The Design-Build Advantage

Choosing a design-build firm like Kitchen Barn offers numerous benefits over hiring basic contractors. Our integrated approach ensures a smoother, more efficient remodeling process:

Z
Single Point of Contact: From design to construction, you work with one dedicated team, simplifying communication and coordination.
Z
Streamlined Process: Our cohesive approach reduces the risk of miscommunication and delays, ensuring your project stays on track.
Z
Expert Guidance: Our experienced designers and builders collaborate to provide innovative solutions and expert advice, helping you make informed decisions.
Z
Quality Assurance: With full control over the entire process, we maintain the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship.
Ready to Love Your Home Again?

Take the first step towards creating the home of your dreams with Kitchen Barn. Our team of experts is ready to guide you through every phase of your home remodeling project, from initial concept to final completion.

Contact us today for a free consultation and let’s start building your dream home together! Experience the difference of working with a dedicated, experienced, and passionate team. Choose Kitchen Barn for your home remodeling needs and transform your house into a home you love.

Accelerated Kitchen or Bath Remodel
Streamlined Design, Management and Project Execution with our Express Kitchen and Bath Remodel

We offer you the chance to achieve your dream Kitchen and Bath faster with our Accelerated Remodel service. Our Express Kitchen and Bath Service is designed for customers who have a time sensitive schedule, that is in need of our expedited process and options without compromising on quality and service.

Enjoy a beautiful, fully functional kitchen and bath in less time, with meticulous attention to detail and exceptional craftsmanship.

h
Initial Express Kitchen and Bath Remodel Consultation (1 Week)

A thorough home consultation to understand your needs and preferences.


Design Phase (1 Week):

We will have you come into our showroom for a design review and signoff. This phase could be completed in 1 visit or 2 visits if additional time or design work is needed. This is a rapid design phase utilizing our expertise to create a functional and beautiful kitchen and/or bath layout.

Cabinet Selection: We carry specific cabinet lines that can be expedited and delivered within a 2 or 3-week period.
Material Selection: Choose from a selection of our trusted vendors’ countertops, moldings, and flooring options.
Fixtures and Cabinet Hardware: We carry an array of options for you to choose the perfect fixtures and cabinet handles/knobs you want us to install.

Place Order (2-3 Weeks)

Depending on the expedited cabinet line selected, there will be a 2-3 week lead time from production to delivery. Once materials are ordered we schedule the construction and Installation to begin after materials are delivered.


Execution (1 Week)

Accelerated Express Kitchen and Bath Remodel construction timeline without sacrificing quality and a seamless executed remodel.

Advantages of our Express Kitchen and Bath Remodel Services
Z
Short Timeline: Get a completed kitchen or bathroom remodel in a much shorter turnaround time.
Z
Fixtures and Hardware: Even with a fast project timeline you will still have access to a large array of our fixtures and hardware options we carry.
Z
Fast and Smooth Execution: Our trusted and experienced team will complete your project swiftly with the highest quality and attention to detail.
Restore Your Kitchens and Bathrooms Beauty?

Take the first step toward creating the space of your dreams with Kitchen Barn. Our team of experts is ready to guide you through every phase of your kitchen remodeling project, from initial concept to final completion.

Contact us today for a free consultation and let’s start building the kitchen you’ve always wanted! Experience the difference of working with a dedicated, experienced, and passionate team. Choose Kitchen Barn for your kitchen remodeling needs and transform your kitchen into a space you’ll love for years to come.

Coastal Design Style
Discover Coastal Design
Contact Us
Coastal design style embodies the serene and relaxed atmosphere of coastal living, bringing a touch of the seaside into your home. It is inspired by the colors and textures found in coastal landscapes, evoking a sense of tranquility and natural beauty.
Elements of Coastal Style

Colors

Coastal design typically features a palette of soft blues, greens, whites, and sandy neutrals. These colors mimic the ocean, sky, sand, and coastal vegetation, creating a calming ambiance.


Accents

Natural materials like driftwood, rattan, and jute are common in coastal design. Accents may include seashells, coral, and marine-themed artwork to emphasize the beach-inspired theme.


Coastal Style in Kitchens

In coastal kitchens, you’ll find:

Crisp White Cabinetry: Reflecting the brightness of coastal mornings.
Light Blue or Green Accents: Reminiscent of ocean hues.
Natural Wood or Light-colored Flooring: Mimicking sandy shores.
Nautical Decor: Such as rope handles or ship-inspired light fixtures.

Coastal Style in Bathrooms

Coastal bathrooms often feature:

Soft Blue or Aqua Tiles: Creating a spa-like atmosphere.
White or Light-colored Vanities: Enhancing brightness.
Shell or Beach-themed Accessories: Adding a whimsical touch.
Glass Shower Enclosures: Allowing natural light to illuminate the space.
Ideal Spaces for Coastal Design

Coastal style thrives in:

Beachfront Homes: Naturally complementing ocean views.
Coastal Cottages and Vacation Homes: Creating a relaxing retreat.
Urban Homes: Bringing a touch of seaside serenity to city living.
Ready to Bring Coastal Bliss into Your Home?

Transform your space with the calming allure of coastal design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you create a coastal-inspired oasis that reflects your love for the sea.

Contemporary Design Style

Contact Us
Contemporary design style embraces the essence of modernity with clean lines, minimalist aesthetics, and a focus on sleek sophistication. It is characterized by a harmonious blend of form, function, and simplicity, creating spaces that are both stylish and functional.
Elements of Contemporary Style

Colors
Contemporary interiors often feature a neutral color palette with shades of white, cream, gray, and black. Bold accents in primary colors or metallic tones may be used sparingly to add visual interest.

Accents
The emphasis is on sleek surfaces and geometric shapes. Materials such as glass, chrome, and polished wood are common, alongside textured fabrics like leather and linen for added depth.

Contemporary Style in Kitchens

In contemporary kitchens, you’ll find:

Clean Lines: Streamlined cabinetry and countertops for a minimalist look.
Neutral Color Scheme: White or gray cabinets with matte finishes.
Sleek Appliances: Stainless steel or integrated appliances for a seamless appearance.
Understated Hardware: Simple, geometric handles or no handles at all for a clean aesthetic.

Contemporary Style in Bathrooms

In contemporary kitchens, you’ll find:

Clean Lines: Streamlined cabinetry and countertops for a minimalist look.
Neutral Color Scheme: White or gray cabinets with matte finishes.
Sleek Appliances: Stainless steel or integrated appliances for a seamless appearance.
Understated Hardware: Simple, geometric handles or no handles at all for a clean aesthetic.
Ideal Spaces for Contemporary Design

Contemporary style is ideal for:

Urban Apartments: Reflecting modern city living with efficiency and style.
Newly Built Homes: Embracing cutting-edge architectural designs.
Minimalist Interiors: Creating clutter-free and visually spacious environments.
Ready to Embrace Contemporary Elegance?

Transform your home with the timeless sophistication of contemporary design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you achieve a modern, minimalist aesthetic that complements your lifestyle.

Cottage Core
Embracing Rustic Charm and Natural Beauty
Contact Us
Cottage core design style celebrates a return to nature with a blend of rustic charm and nostalgic simplicity. Inspired by countryside cottages, this style captures the essence of a cozy, idyllic retreat immersed in natural beauty.
Elements of Cottage Core Style

Colors

Soft, earthy tones dominate in interiors, including shades of sage green, buttery yellow, soft lavender, and warm neutrals like cream and beige. These colors evoke the tranquility of pastoral landscapes.


Accents

Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are prominent in this kind of design. Textured fabrics like linen and cotton add a tactile element, while floral patterns, vintage textiles, and handcrafted ceramics bring a sense of artisanal craftsmanship.


Cottage Core Style in Kitchens

In kitchens, you’ll find:

Vintage-Inspired Cabinetry: Distressed or painted wood cabinets with a worn finish.
Farmhouse Sink: A focal point with a deep basin and apron front.
Open Shelving: Displaying heirloom dishes, pottery, and woven baskets.
Butcher Block Countertops: Warm and inviting with a natural wood grain.

Cottage core Style in Bathrooms

In contemporary kitchens, you’ll find:

Clawfoot Bathtub: Iconic and elegant, often with a vintage-style faucet.
Patterned Tiles: Handcrafted ceramic tiles in floral or geometric patterns.
Antique Mirrors: Ornate frames with a weathered patina.
Wicker Baskets: Functional storage with a touch of rustic charm.
Ideal Spaces for Cottage Core Design

This style thrives in:

Country Homes: Emphasizing a cozy, rural aesthetic.
Farmhouses and Cottages: Capturing the essence of pastoral living.
City Dwellings: Bringing a touch of countryside serenity to urban settings.
Ready to Embrace Cottage Core Charm?

Transform your home with the timeless allure of cottage core design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you create a rustic yet refined sanctuary that reflects your love for natural beauty and artisanal craftsmanship.

European Design Style
Timeless Elegance and Old-World Charm
Contact Us
European design style embodies sophistication, elegance, and a rich cultural heritage rooted in centuries of craftsmanship and artistic expression. This style often combines luxurious materials with intricate details, creating spaces that are both grand and inviting.
Elements of European Style

Colors
Rich, deep hues dominate European interiors, including shades of deep red, gold, olive green, and royal blue. These colors are complemented by warm neutrals like cream, ivory, and taupe, creating a sense of opulence and warmth.

Accents
Ornate detailing and intricate patterns are hallmarks of European design. Furniture and decor often feature carved wood, gilded accents, and luxurious textiles such as velvet, silk, and brocade. Antique mirrors, chandeliers, and tapestries add a touch of historical grandeur.

European Style in Kitchens

In european kitchens, you’ll find:

Custom Cabinetry: Richly stained wood cabinets with intricate detailing.
Marble Countertops: Elegant and timeless, often with intricate veining.
Antique-Inspired Fixtures: Brass or copper faucets and hardware with a vintage look.
Statement Lighting: Ornate chandeliers or pendant lights with crystal accents.

European Style in Bathrooms

European bathrooms often feature:

Freestanding Bathtub: Clawfoot or pedestal tubs with a regal presence.
Luxurious Tiles: Marble or mosaic tiles in intricate patterns.
Gilded Mirrors: Elaborate frames with gold leaf or ornate carvings.
Sculptural Elements: Decorative statues or columns for a classical touch.
Ideal Spaces for European Design

European style thrives in:

Historic Homes: Enhancing architectural details and period features.
Luxury Residences: Creating an atmosphere of refined elegance and opulence.
Formal Settings: Adding a sense of grandeur to dining rooms, libraries, and living areas.
Ready to Embrace European Elegance?

Transform your home with the timeless allure of European design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you create a luxurious sanctuary that reflects your appreciation for Old-World craftsmanship and timeless elegance.

Farmhouse Design Style
Rustic Charm and Cozy Elegance
Contact Us
Farmhouse design style captures the essence of rural living with its blend of rustic charm and understated elegance. Inspired by traditional farmhouses, this style emphasizes comfort, simplicity, and a connection to nature.
Elements of Farmhouse Style

Colors
Soft, muted tones dominate farmhouse interiors, including shades of creamy whites, warm beige, soft grays, and earthy tones like sage green and pale blues. These colors create a serene and inviting atmosphere.

Accents
Natural materials such as wood, stone, and metals are key in farmhouse design. Distressed or reclaimed wood furniture, wrought iron accents, and vintage textiles like linen and cotton add warmth and character. Decorative elements include galvanized metal, mason jars, and floral arrangements.

Farmhouse Style in Kitchens

In farmhouse kitchens, you’ll find:

Farmhouse Sink: A large, apron-front sink that serves as a focal point.
Open Shelving: Displaying vintage dishes, glassware, and kitchenware.
Butcher Block Countertops: Warm and practical, often in natural wood finishes.
Shaker-style Cabinets: Simple and timeless, often painted in white or muted tones.

Farmhouse Style in Bathrooms

Farmhouse bathrooms often feature:

Clawfoot Bathtub: Vintage-inspired with classic charm.
Subway Tiles: White tiles with a clean and timeless look.
Barn Door: Sliding doors add a rustic touch and save space.
Antique Mirrors: Weathered frames or decorative wood frames.
Ideal Spaces for Farmhouse Design

Farmhouse style thrives in:

Country Homes: Emphasizing a cozy, rural aesthetic.
Historic Properties: Enhancing architectural details and period features.
Suburban Homes: Bringing a touch of countryside serenity to modern living.
Ready to Embrace Farmhouse Charm?

Transform your home with the inviting allure of farmhouse design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you create a warm and welcoming sanctuary that reflects your love for rustic elegance and timeless comfort.

French Country Design Style
Elegant Provencal Charm
Contact Us
French country design style evokes the rustic elegance and provincial charm of rural France. Inspired by the picturesque landscapes of Provence, this style combines old-world sophistication with comfortable, welcoming elements.
Elements of French Country Design Style

Colors
Soft, warm hues dominate French country interiors, including shades of sunny yellow, terracotta red, olive green, and lavender. These colors reflect the natural beauty of the French countryside and create a cozy atmosphere.

Accents
Natural materials such as aged wood, wrought iron, and stone are prominent in French country design. Textured fabrics like toile, floral prints, and rustic linens add a touch of elegance. Decorative elements include ceramics, pottery, and woven baskets.

French Country Style in Kitchens

In french country kitchens, you’ll find:

Distressed Cabinetry: Weathered wood cabinets with ornate detailing.
Farmhouse Sink: A large, apron-front sink in porcelain or copper.
Natural Stone Countertops: Marble or limestone with a matte finish.
Open Shelving: Displaying antique pottery, copper cookware, and woven baskets.

French Country Style in Bathrooms

French country bathrooms often feature:

Clawfoot Bathtub: Vintage-inspired with a classic silhouette.
Patterned Tiles: Terra cotta or stone tiles in geometric or floral patterns.
Antique Vanity: A furniture-style vanity with intricate carvings.
Chandelier: Crystal or wrought iron chandeliers for a touch of luxury.
Ideal Spaces for French Country Design

French country style is best suited for:

Country Estates: Embracing the charm of expansive rural properties.
Historic Homes: Enhancing architectural details and period features.
Suburban Residences: Bringing a touch of European elegance to modern living.
Ready to Embrace French Country Elegance?

Transform your home with the timeless allure of French country design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you create a luxurious sanctuary that reflects your love for rustic elegance and provincial charm.

Glamour Design Style
Opulent Elegance and Luxurious Living
Contact Us
Glamour design style exudes opulence, sophistication, and a sense of luxury. It combines rich textures, sumptuous materials, and lavish accents to create spaces that are both glamorous and inviting.
Elements of Glamour Style

Colors
Glamour interiors feature bold and dramatic colors such as deep jewel tones like emerald green, sapphire blue, ruby red, and amethyst purple. These colors are often paired with metallic accents like gold, silver, and chrome to enhance the luxurious feel.

Accents
Luxurious materials such as velvet, silk, and satin are prominent in glamour design. Decorative elements include crystal chandeliers, mirrored surfaces, and ornate details like intricate moldings and trimmings. Faux fur throws, plush rugs, and decorative pillows add comfort and glamour.

Glamour Style in Kitchens

In glamour kitchens, you’ll find:

High Gloss Cabinets: Sleek and reflective surfaces in black or white.
Statement Lighting: Crystal chandeliers or sleek pendant lights with metallic finishes.
Marble Countertops: Polished surfaces with dramatic veining.
Metallic Accents: Gold or silver faucets, cabinet hardware, and appliances.

Glamour Style in Bathrooms

Glamour bathrooms often feature:

Freestanding Bathtub: Sculptural design with a glamorous silhouette.
Mirrored Vanity: Hollywood-style mirrors with built-in lighting.
Glass Mosaic Tiles: Sparkling tiles in intricate patterns.
Luxurious Textiles: Velvet curtains, silk bathrobes, and plush towels.
Ideal Spaces for Glamour Design

Glamour style works best in:

Urban Residences: Adding a touch of luxury to city living.
Contemporary Homes: Enhancing modern interiors with a glamorous flair.
Entertainment Areas: Creating a sophisticated atmosphere for hosting guests.
Ready to Embrace Glamourous Living?

Transform your home with the lavish allure of glamour design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you create a luxurious sanctuary that reflects your taste for opulence and elegance.

Japandi Design Style
Harmonious Blend of Japanese and Scandinavian Aesthetics
Contact Us

“How a spirit travels through a home.”

Japandi design style merges Japanese minimalism with Scandinavian simplicity, resulting in interiors that are both serene and functional. This approach celebrates the beauty of imperfections, embracing beautifully flawed items as part of its aesthetic. Japandi emphasizes minimalism with clean lines and smart, functional spaces.

The style blends natural materials with a strong focus on form and function, incorporating statement art to add character and depth. By combining these elements, Japandi creates a harmonious balance that enhances both the visual and practical aspects of home design.

Elements of Japandi Style

Colors
Japandi interiors feature a neutral color palette with tones of white, gray, beige, and black. These colors create a calming atmosphere, complemented by occasional accents of muted pastels or earthy shades like olive green or terracotta.

Accents
Natural materials such as light wood (like oak or birch), bamboo, and rattan are essential in Japandi design. Decorative accents are minimalistic and purposeful, with a focus on functional items that also serve as decor. Textures like linen, wool, and smooth ceramics add warmth and tactility.

Japandi Style in Kitchens

In japandi kitchens, you’ll find:

Sleek Cabinetry: Clean lines with handleless designs in matte finishes.
Natural Wood Accents: Countertops, shelves, or furniture pieces in light oak or walnut.
Minimalist Decor: Functional kitchenware displayed as decorative elements.
Integrated Appliances: Seamlessly blending into cabinetry for a streamlined look.

Japandi Style in Bathrooms

Japandi bathrooms often feature:

Zen-Inspired Design: Simple and uncluttered spaces with a focus on functionality.
Natural Stone or Wood: Flooring or accents in natural materials.
Neutral Tiles: Clean and geometric tiles in shades of gray or beige.
Functional Storage: Floating vanities or shelves for a clutter-free environment.
Ideal Spaces for Japandi Design

Japandi style works best in:

Urban Apartments: Creating a serene retreat in city living.
Modern Homes: Enhancing minimalist interiors with a touch of warmth.
Spa-Like Settings: Designing tranquil spaces for relaxation and rejuvenation.
Ready to Embrace Japandi Harmony?

Transform your home with the harmonious balance of Japandi design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you create a serene sanctuary that embodies the essence of Japanese minimalism and Scandinavian simplicity.

Mediterranean Design Style
Timeless Elegance Inspired by Southern Europe

Contact Us

Mediterranean design style draws inspiration from the coastal regions of Southern Europe, incorporating elements in a Mediterranean Style Kitchen that reflect the relaxed and sun-soaked lifestyle of countries like Italy, Greece, and Spain. It blends rustic charm with a touch of old-world elegance.

Elements of a Mediterranean Style Kitchen

Colors
Mediterranean interiors feature warm and earthy tones such as terra cotta, ochre, olive green, and deep blues inspired by the sea and sky. These colors create a cozy and inviting atmosphere reminiscent of Mediterranean landscapes.

Accents
Natural materials play a significant role in Mediterranean design, including rough-hewn wood, wrought iron, and clay pottery. Accents often include intricate tile work, colorful ceramics, and handcrafted textiles like embroidered cushions and linen drapes.

Mediterranean Style Kitchen

In mediterranean kitchens, you’ll find:

Terra Cotta Tiles: Flooring or backsplashes with traditional Mediterranean patterns.
Wooden Cabinetry: Rustic, distressed finishes with ornate detailing.
Open Shelving: Displaying colorful pottery, glassware, and cooking utensils.
Warm Lighting: Pendant lights or wrought iron fixtures with amber-toned glass.

Mediterranean Style in Bathrooms

Mediterranean bathrooms often feature:

Terra Cotta Tiles: Flooring or backsplashes with traditional Mediterranean patterns.
Wooden Cabinetry: Rustic, distressed finishes with ornate detailing.
Open Shelving: Displaying colorful pottery, glassware, and cooking utensils.
Warm Lighting: Pendant lights or wrought iron fixtures with amber-toned glass.
Ideal Spaces for Mediterranean Design

Mediterranean style works best in:

Coastal Homes: Emphasizing the connection to the sea and natural surroundings.
Villas or Estates: Enhancing architectural details and outdoor living spaces.
Warm Climates: Creating a cool and inviting interior in sunny environments.
Ready to Embrace Mediterranean Elegance with a Mediterranean Style Kitchen?

Transform your home with the timeless allure of Mediterranean design. Contact us today for a consultation and let Kitchen Barn, Inc. help you create a serene sanctuary that reflects the essence of Southern European charm.

We offer a variety of cabinetry including quick ship, semi custom, full custom and our own fully custom Halco Cabinet. We can design with all price points and styles of cabinetry including overlay, inset and frameless designs.

What is the anticipated timeline?

Interior remodeling 5-7 weeks, project dependent

Addition 12-16 weeks, project dependent

New Construction 6 months - 1 year, project dependent

What is the warranty?

5 Year warranty on all associated projects. Limited lifetime warranty on cabinetry.

What to expect during a remodel?

When a contract has been signed and a deposit is placed, the project moves into the construction phase. A team member will be in touch regarding the schedule and an anticipated start date. You will be given access to your projects online portal where you can review the schedule and associated project documents.

You will be responsible for removing necessary objects from the project area (empty out cabinetry, move furniture, put away décor, etc.)

Our team will secure the area with floor protection and put up plastic walls to decrease the amount of dust and debris from exiting the work area.

We will then work through demo, framing and rough mechanicals, which will all need to be signed off by the town inspector.

Following passed inspections, the board will be hung, finished materials installed and mechanicals completed.

Any final inspections will take place at this time.

How do I start?

It is best to begin the process with a discovery phone call or an in-home consultation. This will allow our team to gain a better understanding of your project and how we can best serve you. We will talk you through our process and answer any initial questions you may have.

About Our Products and Services

We've been helping Sarasota area, Florida homeowners get their dream kitchens and bathrooms for over 49 years. Just because your kitchen or bathroom doesn't work for you now, doesn't mean it couldn't. That's where we come in. Whether you need more storage, a new floor plan or cabinets, we're here to help every step of the way. We pride ourselves on our 96% budget and scheduling accuracy, ensuring your project stays on track and within budget.

S&W Kitchens offers a comprehensive range of remodeling services to transform your home. Learn more about our specialized services:

Kitchen Remodeling
Bathroom Remodeling
Outdoor Kitchens
Home remodeling and renovations

Cabinets

Bath Products

Our professional kitchen and bath designers will assist you in creating the perfect space for you and your family. Then, we'll bring it to life using top-quality cabinets, proudly made in the USA and fixtures, all put together with laser focused precision and beautiful, professional craftsmanship.

What sets us apart is that we blend our professional remodeling design skills with our construction expertise. When you work with S&W Kitchens, you can expect top-notch customer service and communication.

Our Sarasota design and construction teams are under one roof which means you'll save both time and money. We've got your back for the whole project – whether it's praise or blame, it's all on us.

Hiring a remodeling contractor is a big decision. We want to put your mind at ease that you’re working with an established company that is fully licensed, state-certified, and insured. We take our quality standards very seriously.

We are part of industry groups like the NKBA (National Kitchen & Bath Association), the Florida Home Builders Association, several other local building associations, and we are proud to hold the Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS) designation.

At our Sarasota design center, you can explore various cabinet styles, colors, and types in a casual and comfortable setting. Everything's set up like it would be in your own kitchen – cabinets, countertops, and tile selections all in one place. It's the best way to figure out what style suits your perfect kitchen.

And here's the fun part – we can create a virtual kitchen design with state of the art computer technology. That way, you'll get to see the finished project before it’s installed in your home. Cool, right?

We proudly serve the Sarasota metropolitan area and surrounding communities through southwest Florida. Our service area includes: Anna Maria, Bayshore Gardens, Bee Ridge, Bradenton, Bradenton Beach, Cortez, Desoto Lakes, Ellenton, Fruitville, Gulf Gate Estates, Holmes Beach, Kensington Park, Lakewood Ranch, Laurel, Memphis, Nokomis, North Port, North Sarasota, Osprey, Palmetto, Samoset, Sarasota Springs, South Sarasota, The Meadows, Vamo, Venice, Warm Mineral Springs, West Samoset, Siesta Key, South Bradenton, South Gate Ridge, South Venice, West Bradenton, Whitfield, Venice Gardens, Florida and more..

From custom 'Coastal Chic' kitchens in West of Trail neighborhoods to functional master bath updates in Venice and Bradenton, our work spans every style and budget. We tailor our expertise to fit your vision, whether you require a full-scale luxury renovation or a beautiful, high-quality refresh. We’d Love to Hear From You!

At S&W Kitchens and Baths, your dream home is just a conversation away. Whether you're looking to remodel your kitchen, renovate your bathroom, or transform your entire home, our team of experts is here to bring your vision to life.

GET IN TOUCH

If you would like to start your free estimate, you can schedule a consultation with one of our designers.

CONNECT WITH US

Stay connected and up-to-date with our latest projects and more. Sign up for the Design to Divine Newsletter!

VISIT OUR SHOWROOM

Want to see our craftsmanship firsthand? Call or visit one of our beautiful kitchen and bath showrooms. Walk-Ins Welcome!

WINTER PARK

Our Winter Park location is conveniently located on Orange Avenue in the heart of Designer's Row. 

LONGWOOD

Our Longwood showroom is conveniently located near the corner of 434 and Grant St.

WINDERMERE

Our Windermere showroom is located right off of Conroy Windermere Road and Apopka Vineland Road

MELBOURNE

Our Melbourne showroom is conveniently located on North Wickham Road. 

PALM HARBOR

Our Palm Harbor showroom is located off of Ridgemoor Blvd in the plaza with the Starbucks

TAMPA

Our Tampa Showroom is conveniently located right off of South MacDill Avenue

SARASOTA

Our Sarasota showroom is conveniently located in the Rosemary Design District.

Your Dream Kitchen or Bathroom On Budget and On Time...Without the Stress

We help homeowners accurately budget, plan, design, and build any type of remodel.

START MY FREE ESTIMATE

Most Awarded Remodeler In Central Florida:

Why Choose S&W Kitchens

S&W Kitchens is a Florida kitchen, bath and home remodeling company that helps homeowners plan, design, and build a wide range of home renovation and remodeling projects. Thanks to our 49 years of experience, diverse team of professionals, and laser precision estimating, we have the secret sauce to ensure your project is beautifully designed and well-executed from initial consultation to final walk-through.  We’re proud to support American businesses by offering high-quality cabinets that are made in the USA.

 YOUR BUDGET, 
PROTECTED

Home remodels are notorious for coming in over budget. Ours don't. With our meticulous "Project Book" and transparent process, we'll give you a number you can actually count on.

That's why 96% of our projects finish on budget and on schedule.

NO SURPRISES. JUST CLEAR COMMUNICATION.

When you work with S&W, your remodel isn't handed off to a stranger. Our background checked team work together so everyone who touches your home knows the plan, knows the details, and is committed to getting it right. Learn about our process.

49 YEARS. 33 AWARDS. 
7 SHOWROOMS.

Experience matters in remodeling. S&W has been Florida's most trusted remodeler since 1977, earning 33 national awards and growing to 7 showrooms across the state. When you're investing in your home, you deserve a team with a track record to match.

Visit One of Our 7 Florida Showrooms:

Winter Park | Longwood |  Windermere | Melbourne | Palm Harbor | Tampa | Sarasota

Award-Winning Home Remodeling in Florida

Remodeling doesn't have to be stressful, and with the right team, it won't be. You're in the right place.

Since 1977, we've helped thousands of Florida homeowners build kitchens, bathrooms, and homes they love. And with the right team, the remodeling process doesn't have to be stressful. Believe it or not, it can actually be an enjoyable experience. Whether you are looking for a simple refresh or a luxury renovation, we handle everything behind the scenes so you can focus on the fun part: designing the home you've always wanted!

KITCHEN REMODELING

Award-winning designs, from warm-wood classic to modern. 

BATHROOM REMODELING

Spa-like retreats and functional family baths. 

HOME REMODELING

Comprehensive solutions for whole-home renovations and additions.

OUTDOOR KITCHENS

High-end Florida outdoor living and custom entertaining spaces.

Specialty Design Areas

Some projects call for a little more expertise. Here are a few specialized services worth knowing about.

AGING IN PLACE

We believe your forever home should be as functional as it is beautiful. Our designers think through every detail: curbless showers, wider clearance layouts, non-slip flooring that doesn't sacrifice an inch of style. The result is a home that works beautifully for decades to come, guided by our Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS).

Aging in Place Services

LUX REMODELS & RENOVATIONS

Some homeowners want beautiful design along with the finest materials available. Our designers work with you to create spaces that are as thoughtfully planned as they are stunning. Through our partnerships with luxury brands like Poggenpohl and Bentwood, we can deliver both, backed by the same care and craftsmanship S&W has brought to Florida homes since 1977. 

See Our Luxury Remodel Projects

CUSTOM CABINETS

We take pride in offering cabinetry that's made right here in America, crafted with care and attention to detail that ensures it's built for the long run. From warm white oak and walnut to clean contemporary finishes, our selection gives you the quality and craftsmanship your home deserves.

See Custom Cabinetry

See Our Work
TIAGO CIRCLE
OREGON STREET

See more of our remodeling and renovation work:

What Our Clients Say

What stood out was S&W Kitchens' commitment to transparency. I added numerous extras and modifications along the way, and Justin was always clear and straightforward about pricing, costs, and timelines. No surprises, no hidden fees—just honest communication from start to finish. The team is smart, professional, and genuinely pleasant. S&W Kitchens clearly attracts people who take pride in their work. If you're considering a major renovation, I'd strongly recommend S&W Kitchens and specifically ask to work with Justin Champion.

KEVIN L ● ORLANDO, FL

Victoria and Clinton with S&W Kitchens did an amazing job with my new kitchen. It turned out even better than expected. They were mindful of my budget, and created a space that blended beautifully with the adjoining rooms in the house. Thank you so much!!

HILLARY  ● TAMPA, FL
READ MORE REVIEWS
Make Your Remodel Happen Sooner with 0% Financing
LEARN ABOUT FINANCING OPTIONS
Our S&W Team and Values

Your remodel project isn't just assigned to one person; it will be known and supported by the entire S&W team, ensuring seamless coordination, proactive problem-solving, and consistent quality from design through construction.

Our team is made up of award-winning designers, highly experienced project managers, and skilled construction professionals. For your peace of mind, all team members who may work in your home are background-checked and share our commitment to excellence and client satisfaction.

We are proud to support American businesses and ensure superior quality by offering a wide selection of high-quality cabinets that are made in the USA.

Kitchen Remodeling in Orlando & Tampa

It's More Than a Kitchen. It’s the Heart of Your Home.

We design and build stunning, luxury kitchens throughout Central Florida, creating the perfect backdrop to perfectly fit the life you want to live.

SCHEDULE YOUR FREE ESTIMATE

49+ Years in Florida

Award-Winning Design Team

7 Showrooms Across Florida

Let’s Bring Your Kitchen Vision To Life

A kitchen remodel or renovation is one of the most impactful and exciting investments you can make in your home. It’s also a significant undertaking—not just of finances, but of your trust and your time. We understand that you have important questions and high expectations, and you should.

Whether you're looking to update countertops and cabinets or completely reimagine the layout, we tailor our approach to fit your specific goals and vision. We typically partner with homeowners in one of three ways:

Refresh

Perfect for high-impact updates that modernize your kitchen without changing the existing layout.

Full Remodel

Our most popular approach for transforming your kitchen's function, flow, and style, creating a new look and feel.

Luxury Remodel

The ultimate bespoke experience for those who desire a truly one-of-a-kind, chef-inspired luxury kitchen.

No matter the scale of your project, our promise is to honor the importance of this space. A kitchen is more than cabinets and countertops; it’s the backdrop for your life. We replace the uncertainty of remodeling with a transparent, proven process that respects your home, your budget, and your time.

From our very first conversation about how your family lives to the final walkthrough of your new gathering space, our team is here to listen, guide you with expert advice, and manage every detail. We're not just building a kitchen; we're creating the new heart of your home.

SCHEDULE YOUR FREE ESTIMATE

Most Awarded Remodeler In Central Florida:

Our Kitchen Remodel Projects

Every kitchen you see here started with a unique challenge—not enough storage, a closed-off layout, or a style that no longer worked. Explore our recent work in the Orlando and Tampa areas to see how we transformed these frustrations into functional, beautiful kitchens. Find solutions, inspiration and gather ideas for the kitchen that will become the new center of your home. Your transformation starts here.

KITCHEN REMODELING PORTFOLIO
VISIT ONE OF OUR SHOWROOMS

S&W kitchens recently remodeled my kitchen. Jake, Chesleigh and Kerly were wonderful to work with. I was warned this would be a long process, but it was definitely worth it in the end. They addressed all of my issues and made sure everything was perfect. I chose them because they were able to offer ideas and options instead of just asking me what they should do. A great group of people to work with, with an incredible result.

Armand from Orlando

Read More Reviews

Our Remodeling Process

We believe the remodeling experience should be as well-crafted as the final result. We have spent over 49 years perfecting a process that ensures clarity, communication, and peace of mind for our clients.

1

Design Consultation: It starts with a conversation. We visit your  home to measure your space, discuss your goals, and learn about your lifestyle. This ensures the design we create is perfectly tailored to you.

2

Custom Design, Project and Budget Review: Our designers bring your space to life with realistic renderings. You’ll see your new kitchen before construction begins, allowing you to visualize the layout, finishes, and fixtures with confidence.

3

Professional Installation: We handle everything. Your dedicated S&W project manager coordinates our in-house team of installers, ensuring the highest level of service and craftsmanship from demolition to the final tile. Plus we're part of industry groups like the NKBA (National Kitchen & Bath Association), the Florida Home Builders Association, and several other local building associations. See all of our Associations & Memberships.

    "@type": "FAQPage",
    "mainEntity": [
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "I’m going to remodel my kitchen….Can I do some of the work myself to save money?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "Yes. Although we provide all services necessary, we will help coach you through whichever parts of the project you choose to tackle yourself. Often homeowners will ask to perform the demolition portion of the renovation phase. We will offer advice as to the best methods to produce the results you seek."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "I’m remodeling my kitchen. Will I have to hire my own electrician and plumber?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "No. We offer full service remodeling services. We are a licensed General Contractor and we also hold a state plumbing contractor license. However, if you have a great plumber that you want to use, we will work with your provider."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "My neighbor got her kitchen from you and spent $ 10,000.00. Can I do my kitchen for the same amount?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "Maybe! However, every kitchen is different and every homeowner makes different selections that affect the cost up or down. In the event that we could duplicate exactly what your neighbor did, then yes."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "What choices impact the cost of a kitchen remodel the most?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "Construction-related costs due to design changes (ie moving your sink to an island, or removing a dropped ceiling) will have the largest impact. Of course, every design choice you make will impact the cost up or down. Your designer will work with you to get the look you desire at the budget you set."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "I want to replace my cabinetry but I have new floors. Can I redo my kitchen but keep the same floor?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "Absolutely. We can duplicate the same “footprint” without having to touch the floor. At the same time we can make design and storage changes by reconfiguring the components. For example, fitting a Lazy Susan cabinet in a corner exactly where there was a blind corner base."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "Last year we put in beautiful new granite countertops. Our cabinets are solid wood so we didn’t replace them at the time. Now my wife hates the cabinetry. What can I do?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "The perfect solution is to reface the cabinets. We can change the appearance of the cabinetry without touching the counters."
        }
      }
    ]
  }

Everything You Need to Create Your Dream Kitchen

Elevate your kitchen remodel with our top-quality products.

Stop by one of our showrooms and explore our extensive selection of kitchen and bath products from exquisite tiles, backsplash, cabinetry, hardware, fixtures, flooring and more.

CABINETS

When it comes to your kitchen, cabinets are a big deal! They are essential to both style and functionality, making them one of the most important elements for your space.

CABINET REFACING

Revitalize your kitchen with our cabinet refacing services, a smart and cost-effective alternative to a full-scale renovation. 

COUNTERTOPS

We offer an extensive selection of countertops, including granite, quartz,  and marble. Elevate your space with surfaces that not only withstand the demands of daily use but also exude timeless elegance.  

APPLIANCES

We partner with leading appliance manufacturers to bring you solutions that enhance efficiency and also elevate the aesthetics of your space. We're dedicated to helping you choose appliances that integrate into your design, creating a functional and beautiful space..

For nearly 50 years, S&W Kitchens has been the trusted guide for homeowners across Florida, from the white sands of the Gulf Coast to the shores of the Atlantic. We understand that 'remodeling' isn’t just about construction; it’s about making a house work for the way you live today.

Whether you just purchased a dated property that needs immediate updates before move-in, or you are finally ready to invest in the 'forever home' you’ve loved for decades, we meet you where you are.

We don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. Our teams are just as passionate about smart, budget-conscious refreshes—updating surfaces and fixtures to modernize a traditional space, as we are about complex, luxury transformations involving structural changes and custom millwork.

Bathroom Remodeling in Orlando & Tampa

It's More Than a Bath Remodel. It's Your Personal Retreat.

We create beautiful, functional bathrooms in the Orlando and Tampa areas, designed for the life you live today and the one you dream of tomorrow.

SCHEDULE YOUR FREE ESTIMATE

49+ Years in Central Florida

Award-Winning Design Team

7 Showrooms Across Central Florida

A Simple Refresh or Full Transformation

A bathroom remodel or renovation is one of the most exciting transformations you can make in your home. It’s also a significant investment—not just of finances, but of your trust and your time. We understand that you have important questions and high expectations, and you should.

Whether you're looking to update key features or completely reimagine your space, we tailor our approach to fit your specific goals and vision. We typically partner with homeowners in one of three ways: 

Refresh

Perfect for a high-impact that modernizes your space without changing the existing layout.

Full Remodel

Our most popular approach for transforming your bathroom's function and style.

Luxury Remodel

The ultimate bespoke experience for those who desire a truly one-of-a-kind bathroom retreat.

No matter the scale of your project, our promise is to be your dedicated partner on this journey. We replace the uncertainty of remodeling with a transparent, proven process, and we replace the stress of the unknown with constant, clear communication.

From our very first conversation about your ideas to the final walkthrough of your new retreat, our team is here to listen to your needs, guide you with expert advice, and manage every detail with professionalism. Your vision is our blueprint.

SCHEDULE YOUR FREE ESTIMATE TODAY

Most Awarded Remodeler In Central Florida:

Our Bathroom Remodeling Projects

A picture is worth a thousand words, but a successful project tells a complete story. Below is a selection of recent bathroom remodel photos from across the Orlando and Tampa areas, each one a unique solution for a real Florida homeowner. See how we've transformed outdated, frustrating spaces into beautiful, functional retreats that perfectly fit our clients' lifestyles and get inspiration for your next project.

SEE MORE BATH REMODEL PHOTOS
VISIT ONE OF OUR SHOWROOMS

Our experience with S&W Kitchens was refreshingly excellent from start to finish! After two terrible bathroom renovation contractor experiences, we feared the impact of a major kitchen renovation. We got the team of Gina, Mike and Ashley. They were professional, generous with their time, very responsive and wonderfully down to earth. We would highly recommend S&W Kitchens to friends and family for any renovation project. Thank you to the team and all of the trades that renewed our trust in the renovation business.

Liane Y from Tampa

Read More Reviews

Our Remodeling Process

We believe the remodeling experience should be as well-crafted as the final result. We have spent over 49 years perfecting a process that ensures clarity, communication, and peace of mind for our clients.

1

Design Consultation: It starts with a conversation. We visit your  home to measure your space, discuss your goals, and learn about your lifestyle. This ensures the design we create is perfectly tailored to you.

2

Custom Design, Project and Budget Review: Our designers bring your space to life with realistic renderings. You’ll see your new bathroom before construction begins, allowing you to visualize the layout, finishes, and fixtures with confidence.

3

Professional Installation: We handle everything. Your dedicated S&W project manager coordinates our in-house team of installers, ensuring the highest level of service and craftsmanship from demolition to the final tile. Plus we're part of industry groups like the NKBA (National Kitchen & Bath Association), the Florida Home Builders Association, and several other local building associations. See all of our Associations & Memberships.

        "name": "How long does a bathroom remodel typically take?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {

          "text": "The timeline for a bathroom remodel varies depending on the scope of the project. A remodel that includes major construction will be much different than a project that just involves replacing cabinetry."

Everything You Need For Your Dream Bathroom

Swing by one of our showrooms and explore our extensive selection of kitchen and bath products.  From stunning tiles and backsplashes to beautiful cabinetry, hardware, fixtures, flooring, and beyond – we've got you covered. We know every little detail counts when it comes to transforming your bathroom!

BATHROOM CABINETS & VANITIES

When it comes to your bathroom remodel, cabinets are a game-changer for both style and functionality.

Our seasoned bathroom designers are here to guide you, ensuring you have the perfect solution to fit your needs and budget. 

CABINET REFACING

Revitalize your bathroom with our cabinet refacing services, a smart and cost-effective alternative to a full-scale renovation. Our skilled craftsmen will work their magic to give your cabinets a stunning makeover, with plenty of finishes and styles to choose from, so you can get the exact look you want!

COUNTERTOPS

We offer an extensive selection of premium countertop materials, including granite, quartz, marble, and more. Our countertops are sourced from reputable suppliers, so you know you're getting quality that'll last. Our team of pros is here to help you pick the perfect countertop that matches your style and brings out the best in your newly renovated space. 

HARDWARE, FIXTURES, AND MORE!

S&W offers a full range of hardware, fixtures, tubs, and more to help you create the bathroom you've been dreaming of.  Our design pros will help you select the right products for the way you live.

Bathroom Remodeling Service Areas

For nearly 50 years, S&W Kitchens has been the go-to bathroom remodeling partner for homeowners across Florida. from the white sands of the Gulf Coast to the shores of the Atlantic, we understand that a bathroom renovation is personal, it’s about creating a space that offers privacy, comfort, and function for the way you live today.

Whether you have just purchased a home with bathrooms stuck in the 90s, or you are updating your forever home to be safer and more accessible for the future, we meet you where you are.

We pride ourselves on versatility. Our teams are just as skilled at smart, budget-conscious updates, modernizing fixtures, flooring, and lighting to refresh a tired hall bath, as we are at luxury master suite transformations that involve moving plumbing, expanding footprints, and installing custom spa amenities.

Browse our service areas below to see how we bring honest craftsmanship and award-winning design to your neighborhood.

Other Services

S&W Kitchens is a full service home remodeling company. In addition to kitchen remodeling services and bathroom remodeling services, we offer a wide variety of services and products to help make your vision for your home a reality!

Cabinets

 As a premier remodeling and cabinetry company, we specialize in delivering exceptional custom cabinets tailored to our client's unique needs and preferences.

Home Remodeling 

Have more than one room that needs updating? From updating kitchens and bathrooms to revamping living spaces, we've got you covered! 

Closets

Tired of not having enough storage and organization in your home? Our closet designers will work with you to create a custom closet designed just for you.

Outdoor Kitchens

Ready to take your backyard to the next level? Imagine preparing dinner in the sunshine, and gathering with loved ones around a cozy outdoor kitchen. With our expert team, that dream can become a reality

Aging In Place

Are you or a loved one looking to stay in your home as you age? Our aging in place services are here to help make that possible!  Our designers are certified aging in place specialists (CAPS).

Kitchen Products

Just looking for products? Swing by our showroom and explore our extensive selection.  From stunning tiles and backsplashes to beautiful cabinetry, hardware, fixtures, flooring, and beyond – we've got you covered

Bathroom Products

Just looking for products? Swing by our showroom and explore our extensive selection of bath products.  From stunning tiles to beautiful cabinetry, hardware, fixtures, flooring, and beyond – we've got you covered

Laundry Rooms

Transform your laundry room into a space you'll love! From installing efficient storage solutions to upgrading appliances, we'll help you create a laundry room that's both functional and stylish.

Home Bars

Whether you want to create the perfect space for entertaining guests or unwinding after a long day, our remodeling experts will design the perfect home bar tailored to your style and needs.

OUR PROCESS
How a Project Goes

Four steps, one project manager, no surprises.

Free consultation

30 minutes at your home. We see the space and talk options.

Written estimate

Broken out by trade. It holds for 30 days.

Design & order

Selections made and materials ordered before anything is torn out.

Build & walkthrough

Specialists for every trade, then a final walkthrough and written warranty.

HOW WE WORK
Are We the Right Fit?

We’d rather tell you up front than waste your time.

A great fit if…
Your project involves three or more trades. That’s where a general contractor earns their keep.
You want it done right and permitted, not just done cheap.
You want one person to call, a written scope and no surprises.
Probably not if…
You only need one trade. Hire it directly, and we’ll refer the subs we trust.
You’re looking for the lowest number, no matter what’s behind it.
Family owned and operated

You’re talking to the family that owns the company, not a call center.

Faith first

Tell the truth, price fairly, keep our word.

Giving back

We support Rescue Dogs Dream, a dog rescue from Justin’s hometown.

See How We Work →

OUR STORY
Home Is Where
Our Story Begins.

A Tampa Bay remodeling company built around thoughtful design, straight answers, respectful job sites, and work we are proud to stand behind.

2021
SERVING TAMPA BAY SINCE
MEET JUSTIN EICHLER
A Family Dream,
Made Real.

The starting place of love, hopes, and dreams. Growing up in a small town, strong family values were instilled in my siblings and me. I was my dad's right-hand man from a young age.

As I got older, we would talk about how we would start a remodeling business one day to give others the home of their dreams. When my dad passed away, I began to focus even more on making this dream of ours a reality. Remodeling has become a strong passion of mine, and I take pride in transforming a pre-existing space and creating a new masterpiece.

— Justin Eichler, Owner

200+
PROJECTS COMPLETED
5.0★
FROM 87 GOOGLE REVIEWS
CRC1335471

THE BAYSHORE DIFFERENCE
What Makes a Bayshore
Remodel Feel Different.

The Bayshore Difference is not a slogan. It is a clear promise about how we prepare, protect, communicate, and stand behind the work in your home.

01
Clarity Before Disruption.

We define the layout, selections, key materials, and construction direction before your space is opened up, so you have fewer surprises and a clearer path forward.

02
Respect for Your Home.

Dust control, daily cleanup, and thoughtful protection are part of the process—not extras—so the rooms around the project remain cared for.

03
One Team That Owns the Details.

A dedicated project manager coordinates the work, communicates the next step, and walks the finished space with you before we call it complete.

SEE THE FULL BAYSHORE DIFFERENCE →
THE BAYSHORE STANDARD
Trust Has to Be
Built Into the Process.

A remodel is a big thing to hand over to someone. We earn that trust through a detailed plan, honest communication, a protected home, and a written commitment to the work after we leave.

01
Design Before Demolition

Selections, layout, and construction direction are understood before the first tool comes out.

02
Materials Before Demo

For applicable work, cabinetry and key materials are confirmed before your space is opened up.

03
One Accountable Team

A dedicated project manager coordinates the details and keeps communication clear.

OUR WRITTEN PROMISE
Warranty With
Specifics.

We put coverage in writing because “we stand behind our work” is not enough on its own.

2 YEARS
Painting Workmanship

Interior and exterior painting carries a two-year limited warranty for peeling, bubbling, or cracking caused by improper preparation or application.

30 DAYS
Touch-Up Visit

Within 30 days of completion, we return to address normal settling or minor scuffs discovered after you move back in.

1 YEAR
Remodeling Labor

All remodeling labor and workmanship is covered for one year from completion and final walkthrough. We also help clients understand manufacturer coverage on installed products.

READ OUR WARRANTY

THE BAYSHORE DIFFERENCE
The Standards Behind
Every Finished Space.

The difference is not a slogan. It is the planning, protection, communication, and craftsmanship we bring to every room—from the first conversation through the final walkthrough.

01
Plan Before We Open It Up.

For kitchens and baths, the layout, selections, and construction direction are understood before demolition begins, helping prevent avoidable surprises.

02
Protect What We Are Not Remodeling.

Dust control, daily cleanup, and a respectful jobsite are built into the work so the rest of your home stays cared for while your project moves forward.

03
One Vision Across Every Room.

For whole-home work, the kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, paint, built-ins, and transitions are coordinated as one finished environment—not a collection of disconnected decisions.

04
Recommend the Right Cabinet Solution.

We are direct about whether refacing, refinishing, or a larger remodel is the best fit for your cabinet boxes, layout, style, and investment range.

05
Stand Behind the Details.

We communicate clearly, complete a final walkthrough together, and back the work with written coverage and a practical touch-up visit after completion.

06
Specialists With 10+ Years Each.

Every trade on our team, from demolition and plumbing to electrical, tile, carpentry and paint, is a specialist with at least 10 years in that one trade. Together that is more than 50 years of specialized experience on every project, with Bayshore keeping the finish standard, communication and final result accountable.

07
Written Confidence After the Walkthrough.

We complete a final walkthrough together and stand behind our work with written workmanship coverage, so the commitment continues after your space is finished.

OUR APPROACH
The Kitchen Is Where Everyone Ends Up. It’s Worth Getting Right.

We design your kitchen before we touch it — detailed renderings you approve, so you know exactly what you’re getting. Your cabinetry arrives at your home before demolition day, which means your kitchen doesn’t sit torn apart waiting on a delivery truck. And one project manager runs the whole job, so you always know who to call.

Custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, tile backsplashes, lighting, and flooring — handled by one licensed residential contractor instead of five phone numbers.

Detailed renderings approved before any work begins
All cabinets delivered to your home before demolition starts
Locked-in schedule once design is finalized and deposit secured
One dedicated project manager, start to finish
Dust barriers and daily cleanup — your home stays livable
Complimentary 30-minute consultation with the owner
Licensed Residential Contractor CRC1335471 · Fully Insured
WHAT IT COSTS
Kitchen Remodel Pricing

Kitchens vary more than any other room, so here are honest starting points for the three kinds of kitchen projects we do most.

Small Kitchen Remodel
STARTING AT
$28,000
Most projects $28k–$36k

A smaller kitchen with new cabinets, base-level quartz countertops, backsplash and lighting in the existing layout.

Full Kitchen Remodel
STARTING AT
$36,000
Most projects $36k–$50k

New cabinets, quartz countertops, backsplash, flooring and lighting in your existing layout.

Semi-Custom to Custom
STARTING AT
$50,000
Most projects $50k–$85k+

Semi-custom or custom cabinetry, larger kitchens and layout changes. Cabinet grade is the biggest single jump in price.

Cabinets and countertops are included in these ranges. Appliances, light fixtures and faucets are your selections. Typical ranges to help you plan; your written estimate, built after we see your space, is what your project is priced on.

How Long It Takes

Time on site once work starts. Cabinet lead times come first, which is why we order before we demolish.

Small kitchen remodel
3 to 5 weeks
Full kitchen remodel
4 to 6 weeks
Semi-custom to custom
6 to 10 weeks
Small Choices That Move the Number

Each one is worth it for the right kitchen. They just add up, so it helps to know before you say yes.

Under-cabinet lighting
$1,500–$2,200
Each extra recessed light
$200 each
Vented range hood where there’s no vent today
$5,000–$6,000+
Pot filler over the stove
$800
Moving the microwave (new circuit)
$1,000+
Moving the sink
from $800
See every stage of a kitchen remodel, in order →
Why adding a range hood vent costs so much

If your kitchen doesn’t already have a hood vented outside, adding one is a project of its own: ductwork run through the attic and out the roof, a permit, a roofer to flash the roof penetration, a custom hood cover built out around a range hood insert, and the electrical to power it. That combination easily runs $5,000 to $6,000, and more on some homes. The same goes for moving the microwave into a drawer or a new spot: it needs its own new circuit. Neither is a bad choice. They are simply the two items that surprise people most.

What Really Moves a Kitchen Price

Three decisions drive most of the difference between a $28,000 kitchen and a $70,000 one.

Cabinet grade
Stock to semi-custom to custom is the biggest single jump in a kitchen budget.
Countertops
Price climbs through the tiers, then levels off. Past that, it mostly grows with how many slabs the room needs.
Venting, wiring & plumbing moves
A new hood vent, a relocated microwave circuit or moving the sink adds real cost fast.
Refinish, Reface or Remodel?
	REFINISHING	REFACING	FULL KITCHEN REMODEL
What changes	Color and finish	Door and drawer style, plus finish	Everything, including the layout
Countertops	Optional. Keep yours or replace them	Optional, unless we add a cabinet or two	Always replaced, and included in our ranges
Starting price	From $5,000	From $7,000	From $28,000
Time on site	5 to 7 working days	5 to 7 working days	3 to 10 weeks
Best when	Boxes and doors are solid and you like the style	Boxes are solid but you want a new door style	The layout or the cabinet boxes no longer work
Our Warranty, in Writing
1 year
Written workmanship warranty on every project.
Manufacturer
Many of the products we use carry their own material warranties. Because we are licensed professionals installing to the manufacturer’s specifications, those warranties carry through to your project.

Full terms and exclusions are in your signed agreement.

How to Compare Two Kitchen Quotes

A cheaper kitchen quote usually means cheaper cabinets or a lower grade of quartz. Before you compare totals, make sure you’re comparing the same things:

All-plywood cabinet boxes, not particleboard
Dovetail drawer boxes
Soft-close hinges
Soft-close, full-extension drawer slides
The quartz brand and grade (lower grades can discolor)
Quartz used indoors only: it’s made for air-conditioned spaces, and direct sun can yellow it
The same countertop tier and edge profile
Permits included where the work requires them

If one quote leaves any of these out, ask. The difference in price is usually the difference in what you’re getting.

How It Goes
Consultation & 3D design
We start with how you use your kitchen, then build a 3D rendering and cabinet layout and help you choose countertops, backsplash, lighting and fixtures.
Order before demo
We order your cabinets and don’t demolish until they’re ready, so your kitchen never sits gutted.
Build
Demo, rough-in, drywall, cabinets, countertops and backsplash, each by its own specialist.
Walkthrough
Fixtures and appliances connected, punch list closed out, final clean.
Built by Specialists, Not a Jack-of-All-Trades

Every stage of your kitchen is handled by a specialist who only does that trade, and one project manager coordinates them.

Demolition

A complete kitchen done in the right order, permitted when it needs to be.
Honest numbers up front and a clear line between the work and your selections.
To supply your own appliances or fixtures. Most of our customers do.
We’re probably not the right fit if…
You only need one small repair or a single trade. Ask us and we’ll refer someone we trust.
You just want new cabinet color: cabinet refinishing starts at $5,000.

A real waterproofing system behind the tile
A shower pan built and sloped to the drain
A permit when plumbing or electrical moves
Licensed plumbing and electrical
The same tile size and layout
What the allowances cover, and what’s left for you to buy
Whether glass is included

If one quote leaves any of these out, ask why. That’s usually where the price difference lives.

Are We the Right Fit?
We’re a great fit if you want…
A complete bathroom remodel done right, permitted when it needs to be.
Honest numbers up front and a clear line between the work and your selections.
To buy your own materials and have us do the work. That’s a great fit too.
A budget of $15,500+ for a hall bath or $32,000+ for a primary bath.
We’re probably not the right fit if…
You need one small repair, like a regrout or a toilet swap. Ask us and we’ll refer someone we trust.
The lowest price matters more than how it’s built.

4

We complete the room with a final walkthrough together, then you can enjoy a bathroom tailored to your routine, comfort, and style.

OUR APPROACH
One Contractor. One Vision. Zero Coordination Headaches.

A whole-home remodel is the most complex project a homeowner can undertake. We make it simple by handling everything — design, permits, demolition, construction, plumbing, electrical, flooring, painting, and final polish — under one contract, with one project manager who you can call any time.

The Belleair Beach whole-home renovation is our flagship project: exterior, kitchen, living areas, primary suite, bathrooms, flooring, and a custom outdoor shower — all completed by Bayshore Remodels.

Full design plan and 3D renderings before any work begins
One contract, one team, one project manager — start to finish
Kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, painting, and millwork coordinated seamlessly
Permits pulled and inspections managed by our team
Dust barriers, daily cleanup, respectful jobsite throughout
Complimentary 30-minute consultation with the owner
Licensed Residential Contractor CRC1335471 · Fully Insured
WHAT IT COSTS
Whole Home Remodel Pricing

A whole-home project is a collection of decisions. Here is what the most common pieces cost, so you can see how a full remodel adds up.

New Floors Throughout
STARTING AT
$15,000
Most homes $15k–$25k

Old flooring out, new LVP or tile in, with baseboard, for a typical 1,500 to 2,000 sq ft home.

Paint, Inside & Out
STARTING AT
$14,000
Most homes $14k–$22k

Interior walls, ceilings and trim plus the exterior, for a typical 1,500 to 2,000 sq ft home.

Full Whole-Home Remodel
STARTING AT
$150,000
Kitchen, baths, floors & finishes

Floors, baseboard, doors, interior and exterior paint, the kitchen and the bathrooms.

Typical ranges from our recent projects to help you plan. Your written estimate, built after we walk the house, is what your project is priced on.

Pricing for the Pieces

Most whole-home projects are built from these. The numbers are fairly steady from house to house.

LVP flooring, installed with material
$7–$9 per sq ft
Tile flooring, installed with material
$17–$22 per sq ft
Baseboard, installed with material
$10–$12 per foot
Interior doors, installed
$275 each plus the door
Interior paint
$4–$5 per sq ft of home
Exterior paint
most homes $7,000–$12,000
The one flooring surprise: uneven floors

Flooring prices are pretty predictable. The one thing that can add cost is what we find after the old floor comes up. If large areas of the slab are uneven, they have to be self-leveled before new LVP or tile goes down, or the new floor will flex, click and crack. We price it after demolition, once we can actually see it, and only when it’s needed.

Kitchen pricing →    Bathroom pricing →    Painting →
Why Permitted Work Costs More

When a kitchen or bathroom is permitted, it has to meet today’s code, not the code the house was built to. In a kitchen that usually means new dedicated circuits for the dishwasher, disposal, microwave and refrigerator. In a bathroom it means protected circuits near water, a vent fan that exhausts outside, and plumbing and shower waterproofing that pass inspection. In both, most municipalities now require arc-fault protection on new circuits, which can lead to more rewiring in older homes. It’s a real cost in every permitted room, and it’s the right way to do it.

How It Goes
Walkthrough & priorities
We walk every room with you and sort what matters most from what can wait.
Plan the order
Kitchen and bathrooms first, then floors, then baseboard and doors, with paint last so nothing gets touched up twice.
Build
Each stage handled by its own specialist, coordinated by one project manager.
Final walkthrough
Room by room, punch list closed out, final clean.
Built by Specialists, Not a Jack-of-All-Trades

A whole-home remodel touches almost every trade. Each one is a specialist who only does that work, and one project manager keeps them in order.

Demolition
Licensed Plumbing
Licensed Electrical
Flooring
Drywall
Finish Carpentry
Painting
One Project Manager
Our Warranty, in Writing
1 year
Written workmanship warranty on every project.
2 years
Against blistering and peeling on painted finishes, inside and out.
Manufacturer
Many of the products we use carry their own material warranties. Because we are licensed professionals installing to the manufacturer’s specifications, those warranties carry through to your project.

Full terms and exclusions are in your signed agreement.

How to Compare Two Whole-Home Quotes

On a project this size, what’s left out matters more than the total. Ask every contractor:

Are permits included where the work requires them?
Is each trade licensed where it needs to be?
Who sets the order of the work and keeps the schedule?
Which materials are included, and which are allowances?
Are demolition, haul-off and cleanup included?
How are surprises found behind walls or under floors handled?

The cheapest whole-home quote is often the one that leaves the most for later.

Are We the Right Fit?
We’re a great fit if you want…
Several rooms done in the right order by one team.
Honest numbers up front for every piece, so you can decide what to do now and what can wait.
To supply some of your own materials. That works too.
We’re probably not the right fit if…
You only need one room or one trade. Ask us and we’ll point you in the right direction.
You’re looking for carpet. We focus on LVP, tile and hardwood.

All materials are delivered to your home before demolition starts — no waiting, no delays.

OUR APPROACH
Professional Cabinet Refinishing — Shop-Quality Finish, In Your Home.

We remove every door and drawer and transport them to our dedicated spray shop, where they receive a premium water-based commercial-grade coating — the same finish used on factory-built cabinetry. While your doors are at the shop, we prep your kitchen: seal it off with dust barriers, fill all nail holes, sand surfaces smooth, and run air scrubbers.

A BETTER FIRST STEP
Home Remodeling
Starts With Trust.

You do not need to have every finish selected or every decision made. Start by telling us about the space, the goals, and the way you want your home to work. We will help you understand a sensible next step.

(813) 489-1552
Call us directly if you prefer to start by phone.

2101 Starkey Rd Unit M6, Largo, FL 33771
