FULL BASEMENT BUILD-OUTS FOR MULTI-FUNCTIONAL SPACES

A full basement build-out involves careful planning and coordination. Our process covers everything from framing to painting, ensuring a seamless transition from a bare space to a fully functional area ready for use. 

Material and labor costs include framing, insulation, switches, outlets, can lights, HVAC ventilation, drywall, taping, doors, trim, painting, and carpet. Additional features like detailed trim or Egress windows will add to the cost.

Compact and Stylish ¾ Basement Bathroom Additions

We specialize in designing and implementing stylish and compact bathrooms, complete with quality fixtures and finishes such as faucets, shower heads, towel bars, and lighting fixtures.

Our team’s extensive experience and skill allow us to provide accurate bids and plans, ensuring your project is completed on time and within budget.

¾ bathroom additions assume a 45-square-foot bathroom including a vanity, toilet, flooring, and shower stall with a full-frame glass door. The final price will be affected by the quality of cabinetry, countertops, fixtures, tile, and drains.

Basement Wet/Dry Bars: Ready for Entertainment

Imagine a space in your home renovated specifically for gatherings, parties, or even a tranquil evening with a favorite book and a glass of wine. That dream can become a reality.

Whether you envision an understated dry bar with exquisite cabinetry or a fully-equipped wet bar, our team skillfully blends your preferences with our expertise, creating a bespoke entertainment space in your remodeled basement.

A standard-level wet bar comes with a sink, faucet, and an island or peninsula section for bar stools. A premium-level wet bar is a more customized space for gatherings and includes multiple appliances and a high-end finish.

Create the Ultimate Man Cave or Family Space in Your Basement

Want to carve out a personal sanctuary or a family space in your basement? Turn your basement conversion into the ultimate man cave, complete with high-tech entertainment systems, comfortable seating, customized lighting, and stylish bars. Create an environment for gaming, watching sports, or simply unwinding at the end of the day. 

Comfortable Basement Bedrooms for Your Guests

Our team is adept at crafting cozy and welcoming guest bedrooms as part of basement renovations. With thoughtful layout plans and keen attention to details such as lighting, ventilation, and acoustic insulation, we ensure your guests enjoy a comfortable stay. Not only does this increase your property value, but it also gives you extra space for hosting guests comfortably.

Tailored Basement Offices for Optimal Work-from-Home Solutions

In today’s increasingly digital and remote working landscape, a dedicated home office has become more than just a luxury—it’s a necessity. We start your basement remodel by understanding your specific work needs, style preferences, and ergonomic requirements.

Armed with this information, we design your home office to promote productivity and minimize distractions. Our designs focus on integrating ample workspace, clever storage solutions, and appropriate lighting to reduce eye strain and improve the overall ambiance.

Fun-Filled Basement Playrooms for Your Little Ones

A basement playroom is a safe haven for creativity and fun where children can explore and learn. We focus on delivering a balanced combination of open play areas and organized storage, allowing for an engaging, tidy, and stimulating environment.

By understanding your children’s interests, we create designs with color schemes, textures, and furniture that kindle imagination and provide comfort. Prioritizing safety, we use non-toxic materials, incorporate child-friendly furniture, and ensure adequate, comfortable lighting. 

WHY COMMUNICATION MATTERS DURING A REMODEL

Remodeling projects involve hundreds of moving parts, from design decisions and material deliveries to trade scheduling and inspections. Questions and unexpected situations are inevitable. The strongest projects aren’t necessarily the ones without challenges—they’re the ones where homeowners and contractors communicate openly and address issues quickly.

The team at GMH uses JobTread for consistent communication that reaches multiple team members simultaneously resulting in quicker, more collaborative response. If the situation is an emergency, we can always be reached by phone.

Don’t be afraid to ask questions, share concerns, or seek clarification. A good remodeling team wants you informed and comfortable throughout the process. Clear communication helps prevent misunderstandings, reduces stress, and keeps everyone working toward the same goal.

GMH REMODELING: YOUR GO-TO HOME ADDITION CONTRACTOR

YOUR TRUSTED HOME ADDITION CONTRACTORS FOR A WIDE RANGE OF SERVICES

As experienced home addition contractors, we offer a diverse suite of home addition and expansion services. Whether it’s constructing a new room, broadening an existing one, or transforming a currently underused space, our team of expert addition builders is here to guide you at every step. Check out our home addition testimonials to see what our past customers have to say!

	
Expert Addition Contractor for Room Additions

There could be numerous reasons you might require an additional room in your home. Perhaps your family is expanding, you need a dedicated workspace, or maybe you want an extra bathroom for added convenience. Regardless of your needs, our team of experienced contractors for home additions works diligently to create a space that is not only functional but also integrates seamlessly with the rest of your home.

	
Skilled Bump-Out Addition Builders

Sometimes, a full room addition isn’t required. A small extra space can significantly enhance the functionality and comfort of an existing room. Bump-out additions are perfect for installing a bay window to your living room, broadening your kitchen, or creating an alcove in your bedroom. Our expert addition builder team handles every aspect of bump-out additions, from design to execution, assuring a smooth and efficient process.

	
Sunroom Addition Contractor Services

Imagine a space in your home to enjoy nature’s beauty without stepping out. Our sunroom addition contractor services can bring this to life. Whether it’s a solarium, garden room, Florida room, or an atrium, we can construct a serene space that not only increases your home’s aesthetic value but also enriches your bond with nature.

	
Transformative Garage Conversions

Is your garage idle and underutilized? Why not convert it into a functional living space? Our garage conversion services can remodel your garage into a bedroom, a home office, a game room, or any other space you desire. Our team of proficient home addition contractors ensures that the transformed space aligns perfectly with your needs and blends seamlessly with the rest of your home.

	
Second Story Additions by Expert Home Addition Contractors

If your home has limited yard space, yet you need more room, a second-story addition or attic conversion could be your solution. Our expert team of home addition contractors excels at crafting second-story additions that integrate flawlessly with your existing home structure. This means you acquire the needed space without compromising your home’s aesthetics.

	
In-Law Suite Additions

Whether it’s for an aging parent, a returning adult child, or guests, an in-law suite can be a valuable extension to your home. As your dedicated room addition contractor, we can create a granny flat, guest suite, accessory dwelling unit (ADU), or multi-generational living space that assures comfort and privacy.

COMPREHENSIVE 3 AND 4 SEASON ROOM ADDITIONS

Season rooms are increasingly popular additions, allowing you to bask in the diverse climate of Wisconsin from the comfort of your home. These unique spaces skillfully merge indoor comfort with an outdoor ambiance, providing you with the best of both worlds.

At GMH Remodeling, we specialize in constructing both 3 and 4 season room additions. These innovative designs are well-insulated, energy-efficient, and seamlessly incorporated into your existing home design. Tailored to suit your specific needs, our season rooms can serve various functions, such as a dining area, lounge, playroom, or even an indoor garden space.

3 Season Room Additions

Our 3 season rooms are a fantastic solution for those who wish to enjoy the beautiful seasons of Wisconsin without being affected by the occasional inclement weather. These spaces are specially designed to be used from spring through fall, offering panoramic views of your outdoor scenery while protecting you from rain, wind, and pests. Designed with flexibility in mind, a 3 season room can easily be upgraded to a 4 season room in the future should you wish to do so.

		
4 Season Room Additions

Our 4 season room additions are an excellent choice for homeowners seeking year-round comfort. These rooms are constructed with fully insulated glass and climate control features, ensuring that you can enjoy your space in any weather, be it the heat of summer or the frost of winter. A 4 season room can become a serene retreat for relaxation, an inviting space for socializing, or a cozy spot for family gatherings.

As experienced room addition contractors, our team at GMH Remodeling is proficient in ensuring that your 3 or 4 season room addition harmoniously blends with your home’s existing architecture. We consider all elements, including matching rooflines, siding, and windows, to create a seamless integration.

OUR REMODELING PROCESS FOR HOME ADDITIONS

We’re here to meet your needs, and our simple home addition process checks off all the boxes:

Schedule a free consultation to determine if we’re a good fit
We’ll visit your home and establish a plan that fits your budget

Build!

Throughout the building process all our customers can stay up-to-date in real-time with our Co-Construct smartphone application. Access your project’s information and timeline at the swipe of a finger.

EXPANDING YOUR HOME: UNDERSTANDING THE INVESTMENT

Home additions can dramatically improve the way a home functions, but they are often a larger investment than homeowners anticipate.

Many basic 500-square-foot “white-box” additions start around $200,000 before interior finishes and remodeling are included. While kitchen additions frequently range from $280,000–$450,000 and primary suite additions often fall between $300,000–$500,000. Final costs depend on factors such as structural requirements, interior and exterior finishes, site conditions, and how much of the existing home is being remodeled in addition to the new space.

MODERN AMENITIES:

ADDRESSING STRUCTURAL ISSUES:

At GMH Construction we pride ourselves on clear communication and setting proper expectations with our clients, including understanding the remodeling process. Design-Build means all the key aspects of your project are integrated within a single team – from the design phase to to product selections to space renovation to warranty. Working with our Southeast Wisconsin Design-Build firm also means we are your single point of contact for consistent communication and maintaining the budget and schedule.

WHAT IS GMH CONSTRUCTION’S SIGNATURE SERIES

The Signature Series by GMH allows our customers to take advantage of our well-honed remodeling process, skilled tradespeople and top-tier suppliers while remaining budget-friendly. Simplified project scopes and reduced selection varieties keep a project moving through the process efficiently. Our Signature Series is focused on semi-custom results.

What Types of Projects Are in Scope?

GMH’s Signature Series is designed to offer affordable, semi-custom remodeling services for bathrooms, basements and kitchens.

What Does Semi-Custom Mean?

Semi-custom remodels allow personalized modifications to pre-selected materials and designs within the limited choices of the Signature Series renovation process.

Can I Make Structural Changes?

No. Projects within the scope of the Signature Series are renovations with little to no structural changes. The Signature Series offers an affordable, streamlined process.

Can I Choose the Materials?

Yes! The selection of materials such as flooring, plumbing, countertops and cabinetry is simplified. Clients choose from a curated selection of our popular items in each category. The limited variety of selections keeps projects within budget.

HOW THE PROCESS WORKS: SIGNATURE SERIES

The Signature Series from GMH Construction offers a streamlined, semi-custom remodeling process for kitchens, basements and bathrooms. The process begins with an initial consultation to discuss the project scope, budget and design preferences within a curated selection. We’ve included our most popular materials like flooring, plumbing fixtures, countertops and cabinetry. Once selections are finalized, GMH’s in-house team handles every aspect of the renovation, from design to construction to final installation. The integrated design-build approach provides a single point of contact for communication and a proven, successful remodel.

The figure accounts for flooring, backsplash, cabinetry, stone countertops, sink, faucet, electrical and lighting updates, and skilled labor.

Basement

Transforming an unfinished basement into a functional living space increases the value and livability of a home. The Signature Series price estimate for a 750-square-foot basement renovation falls between $70,000 and $92,000. The range covers the installation of necessary utilities, framing, insulation, flooring and the creation of customized living areas tailored to your lifestyle.

Main Bathroom

The main bathroom is a crucial space and requires careful attention to detail. The Signature Series price estimate for a main bathroom renovation falls between $35,000 to $48,000. The estimate encompasses finishes, modern fixtures and efficient layouts, creating a spa-like atmosphere in your home’s comfort. Includes up to 48″ vanity cabinet, countertop with sink & faucet, acrylic tub & surround, shower head and tub spout, shower rod, toilet, vanity light, and LVP flooring. This pricing does not include any tile materials or labor.

Owner Bathroom

The owner’s bathroom, often referred to as the master bathroom, is a personal sanctuary. The Signature Series price estimate for an owner bathroom renovation ranges from $50,000 to $65,000. The investment ensures a sophisticated and indulgent space featuring beautiful materials, innovative designs and an upgraded feel. This includes, up to 60″ vanity cabinet only, stone top with sink & faucet, acrylic shower unit with shower head and glass shower door, free-standing tub with spout, LVP flooring, and vanity lights. Does not include any tile materials or labor.

WHY COMMUNICATION MATTERS DURING A REMODEL

Remodeling projects involve hundreds of moving parts, from design decisions and material deliveries to trade scheduling and inspections. Questions and unexpected situations are inevitable. The strongest projects aren’t necessarily the ones without challenges—they’re the ones where homeowners and contractors communicate openly and address issues quickly.

The team at GMH uses JobTread for consistent communication that reaches multiple team members simultaneously resulting in quicker, more collaborative response. If the situation is an emergency, we can always be reached by phone.

Don’t be afraid to ask questions, share concerns, or seek clarification. A good remodeling team wants you informed and comfortable throughout the process. Clear communication helps prevent misunderstandings, reduces stress, and keeps everyone working toward the same goal.

THE GMH DESIGN CENTER
Where Ideas Take Shape

Every successful remodel starts with a clear vision. At GMH Construction, our Design Center is where that vision begins to take form.

This dedicated space allows homeowners to explore materials, refine ideas, and collaborate directly with our design team. From cabinetry and countertops to fixtures, finishes, and layout planning, the Design Center helps turn inspiration into a thoughtful, well-planned project.

More importantly, it’s where conversations happen—about how your space will look, how it will function, and how every detail fits within your budget and timeline.

Explore the Space

Our Design Center was created to make the design process easier and more enjoyable for homeowners. Instead of trying to imagine how selections might work together, you can see materials, textures, and finishes in person.

Here, you’ll work closely with our designers to explore options, compare materials, and develop a design that reflects both your style and the way you live in your home.

The result is a clearer vision and a smoother path from concept to construction.

Guided by Experience

At GMH Construction, design is about far more than selecting finishes. Our designers understand the entire remodeling process—from the first concept to the final build.

Because our team works closely with production managers and builders throughout the design phase, we’re able to anticipate challenges, guide decisions, and ensure that every design aligns with your budget, schedule, and long-term goals.

Communication plays a critical role in this process. Our designers act as the connection point between clients, the production team, and the rest of the GMH staff, helping keep your project organized, efficient, and moving forward smoothly.

But just as important as the technical side of remodeling is the human side.

Remodeling your home can feel overwhelming at times. It’s an emotional process that involves your investment, your lifestyle, and the spaces where your family gathers every day. Our team is passionate about supporting clients through each step, helping them feel confident in their decisions and comfortable with the process.

From Concept to Completion

One of the greatest advantages of working with GMH Construction is that your project stays within one integrated team—from design all the way through construction.

Our designers collaborate closely with the production team throughout the process, ensuring that every detail has been thoughtfully considered before building begins. This collaboration helps prevent surprises, keeps communication clear, and allows your project to move forward with confidence.

We spend the time getting to know your goals, your style, and how you want your space to function. From there, we help bring those ideas together into a design that feels uniquely yours.

Creating Spaces That Feel Like Home

For our designers, the most rewarding moment comes at the end of the project—when homeowners step into their finished space and feel that everything came together exactly as they hoped.

Because great design isn’t just about beautiful materials or clever layouts.

It’s about creating spaces where people feel comfortable, inspired, and truly at home.

DELAFIELD HOME REMODELING CONTRACTORS
INTERIOR REMODELING SERVICES FOR DREAM MAKEOVERS

GMH Construction’s proven home remodeling contractors create stunning interiors for Delafield, WI, homeowners. We specialize in whole-house remodels, kitchen renovations and basement finishing to elevate your living space. From modern kitchen upgrades to basement theaters or music studios, we bring your ideas to life with professional design-build solutions.

With nearly 30 years of experience, GMH Construction provides quality craftsmanship at a price tailored to your budget. We offer fixed pricing for every project, providing you with clarity and confidence from start to finish.

Looking for custom home remodeling in Delafield, WI? Contact GMH Construction today for a complimentary consultation and let us help create your dream home.

Contact Us
KITCHEN RENOVATIONS IN DELAFIELD, WI

GMH Construction has remodeled kitchens in Delafield for more than 30 years. Our kitchen remodeling team works with you to select countertops, flooring, plumbing, lighting, appliances and finishes.

Kitchen remodeling projects in Delafield typically range from $60,000 to $80,000, depending on size and materials.

Kitchen Remodeling
BASEMENT FINISHING & REMODELING SERVICES

Transform your basement into a functional extension of your home. GMH Construction offers full basement finishing, remodels and additions in Delafield, WI.

Popular basement projects include:

Full basement finishing

Home offices 
Laundry, bath & bathroom additions
Basement bar & kitchen remodeling

Basement remodeling in Delafield generally ranges from $55,000 to $100,000. Whatever your vision, our home remodeling contractors deliver exceptional results at an affordable price.

BATHROOM REMODELING & HOME ADDITIONS IN DELAFIELD, WI

Our bathroom remodeling services include spa tubs, walk-in showers, basement baths and premium furniture. Bathroom projects usually range from $27,000 to $55,000, based on layout and finish materials. We provide transparent pricing and help you choose options for your budget and style.

Every homeowner has specific requirements for expanding their living space. GMH Construction’s home addition contractors possess the expertise to comprehend your needs, preferences and lifestyle to design and build ideal expanded living spaces. Perfect for room additions, patio enclosures, garage conversions and 3 and 4-season rooms.

WHY CHOOSE GMH CONSTRUCTION?

For over 30 years, GMH Construction has been the trusted choice for interior home remodeling in Delafield. We provide complete services, including kitchen and basement renovations, bathroom remodels and large-scale additions. Our simple 3-step design-build process makes every project efficient and straightforward.

The GMH team takes pride in delivering remarkable remodeling experiences and lasting results. We proudly serve Delafield and Southeast Wisconsin with reliable home improvement services.
